# Advisor effect data sources

Checked October 2, 2026 against primary documentation, live public APIs, extracted CardDefs and exact npm packages. Research only; no application changes or dependency updates. Extends [September 26 source research](battlegrounds-advisor-external-sources-2026-09-26.md) and [ecosystem research](ecosystem-and-data-sources.md).

## What actually addresses these gaps

**Add build-matched raw CardDefs metadata and an automatically generated effect-coverage inventory; implement a shared recruit effect catalogue.** More card-text feeds alone will not fix the recent failures. Tavern Lens already has build-keyed HearthstoneJSON, readiness/cost from live entity tags, and the older `TavernSpellEffect` table even contains Fortify. The newer `RecruitEffects.effect` grammar lacks its health-only wording; `RecruitActivations` lacks Lionfish/Living Prison; `RecruitLogEffects.supportsTrinket` lacks the completed Ornate Clock classification. [Card data model](../../Sources/HSData/CardDB.swift), [recruit effects](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitEffects.swift), [activation rules](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitActivations.swift), [existing Fortify rule](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/TavernSpellEffects.swift), [trinket classification](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitLogEffects.swift)

No current, permissively reusable, complete recruit rules engine was established by this investigation. Metadata can identify dependencies, costs and changed definitions; executable semantics still need implementation and replay validation. The parallel [decision-environment investigation](advisor-decision-datasets-2026-10-02.md) found a useful narrower reference: HSBRSIM’s newer `hsrl2` has Lionfish and Living Prison [activation scripts](https://github.com/Gallo13th/HSBRSIM/blob/4e0525a198352557ef816bd3a53566d6ffd4c164/hsrl2/scripts/batches/batch_activate.py) and [tests](https://github.com/Gallo13th/HSBRSIM/blob/4e0525a198352557ef816bd3a53566d6ffd4c164/hsrl2/tests/test_batch_activate.py). Its older RL wrapper targets a different engine, and these tests do not establish full client parity. README MIT claims lack a detected standalone license; verify reuse and behavior before adopting code.

## Ranked additions and extensions

| Priority | Source / existing integration | Useful addition | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **HearthSim `hsdata/CardDefs.Bacon.xml`**, upstream of already integrated HearthstoneJSON | Raw numeric tags, script parameters, activation markers and token DBF links; exact-build coverage inventory | Extracted client metadata, not executable server rules. Game data remains Blizzard's; repository has no declared software license |
| 2 | **HSBG Cards `/api/v1`**, already known; Tavern Lens uses a pool override | Resolved token relationships, normal/golden details and patch-diff cross-checks | Does not supply state transitions or live counters. Relationships require validation; current API is not an exact-build substitute |
| 3 | **Firestone simulator 1.1.755**, already bundled | Existing executable Fishbait/deathrattle and combat trigger behavior as a reference for event semantics | Combat interfaces include some battlecries/spells, but no complete recruit action engine; newer releases changed license |
| 4 | **Amalgadon v1**, new provider | Alternate card lookup, patch comparisons and shareable board tooling | Another HearthstoneJSON-backed metadata layer; no documented executable effects or activation counters; data endpoints require a key |
| 5 | **Blizzard cards API + official patch notes**, previously researched | Independent text/pool changes and freshness alarms | OAuth/service dependency for cards; no executable recruit rules. Patch notes describe changes, not complete state transitions |

### 1. Raw CardDefs: concrete extra information

The requested game build **253216** exists at hsdata tag `253216`, commit `5e9743bc97bbfd0195eb63a30c18bf9eea32814b`. Its XML root reports `build="253216"`. Current master is already **253932**, commit `27fbd2323aec20cab1c6ecc7d5f55cf12729f956`, patch 36.6.3. Fetch the matching tag, rather than attaching today's rules to the previous game's recording. [Exact-build CardDefs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HearthSim/hsdata/5e9743bc97bbfd0195eb63a30c18bf9eea32814b/CardDefs.Bacon.xml), [current commit](https://api.github.com/repos/HearthSim/hsdata/commits/27fbd2323aec20cab1c6ecc7d5f55cf12729f956)

Verified in the **253216 XML**:

| Card | Structured facts omitted from Tavern Lens `Card` | What still needs a rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fortify `BG28_503` / DBF 103791 | Script parameter tag **3 = 3**; Taunt is a `ReferencedTag`; text contains health-only and attack/health variants | Health-only target buff plus Taunt; a referenced keyword is not an instruction to apply it |
| Lionfish `BG36_201` / 132794 | **4089 = 1** (`INTERACTABLE_OBJECT`), **4090 = 2** (base activation cost), **2519 = 132802** (`BACON_EVOLUTION_CARD_ID`) | Target a Tavern card, replace it, have the leftmost Beast attack, resolve recruit triggers |
| Golden Lionfish `BG36_201_G` / 132795 | **2519 = 132803**; same activation marker/base cost | Same event sequence with golden Fishbait |
| Fishbait `BG36_205` / 132802; golden / 132803 | Script tags **2/3 = 5/5**, golden **10/10**; normal-to-golden tag **1429**, reverse **1471** | Cannot gain stats; deathrattle buffs its killer. Triggered attacks may activate other board/trinket effects |
| Living Prison `BG36_180` / 133453 | Activation marker; **4090 = 1**; golden link **1429 = 133454** | Arm a pending effect and consume it on the next purchased minion this turn; golden doubles the copied stats |
| Arcane Absorption `BG35_911` / 130311 | Cost 1, tier 4, Elemental subset marker | Select the highest-Health Tavern minion and transfer half its stats to a friendly Elemental; verify ties/rounding from observed play |
| Ornate Clock `BG32_MagicItem_271` / 121120 | Trinket category and printed one-time effect | Distinguish an acquisition effect already reflected in gold from future recruit/combat effects; do not grant its gold again |

These facts all come from [the pinned XML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HearthSim/hsdata/5e9743bc97bbfd0195eb63a30c18bf9eea32814b/CardDefs.Bacon.xml). CardDefs does **not** identify which generic script parameter means a buff, cost or counter across every card. Preserve raw integer IDs and explicit missing values; unknown tag names sometimes appear as `name="1"`.

HearthstoneJSON documents build/locale separation and conversion from these files. Tavern Lens's exact-build JSON request returned **403 in this research environment**; the matching raw XML returned **200**. This is an additional metadata path, not evidence that the app's existing cached JSON is missing. The site's CC0 license is separate from Blizzard's game-data rights. [HearthstoneJSON source/provenance](https://hearthstonejson.com/)

### 2. HSBG relationships are available, but not instructions

Live `/api/v1/cards/132794/related` returned **200** and resolved Lionfish to Fishbait 132802 and Lionfish Portrait 133388. Its `parent`, `children` and `mentions` include the Portrait in more than one position; the graph cannot be interpreted as an ordered execution plan. Living Prison's related response has no children. Golden DBFs 132795/132803 are reported as `notFound` by batch lookup, while their normal records contain `dbfIdGold` and `textGold`: normalize those variants explicitly. [Verified Lionfish relationships](https://hsbg.cards/api/v1/cards/132794/related), [Living Prison relationships](https://hsbg.cards/api/v1/cards/133453/related), [verified batch](https://hsbg.cards/api/v1/cards?identifiers=132794,132795,132802,132803&pool=all)

The documented v1 contract supports related cards and historical states, with snapshot provenance. Anonymous access allows 120 requests/minute; cache and batch. Live latest patch data resolves to 36.6.3, generated October 1. Terms permit community use with attribution and restrict competing mirrors and excessive scraping; no guarantee of completeness/freshness. [API contract](https://hsbg.cards/api-docs), [latest patch data](https://hsbg.cards/api/v1/patches/latest), [terms](https://hsbg.cards/terms)

### 3. Firestone: version-specific licensing and partial executable coverage

The exact pinned tarball **1.1.755** and registry record declare **MIT**. Latest **1.1.765**, published October 1, declares **All rights reserved**; the observed switch starts at **1.1.761**, September 28. September's blanket statement that the simulator is MIT must not be applied to future versions. `reference-data` latest 3.0.213 still declares MIT. This research did not update dependencies. [Pinned registry record](https://registry.npmjs.org/@firestone-hs/simulate-bgs-battle/1.1.755), [latest registry record](https://registry.npmjs.org/@firestone-hs/simulate-bgs-battle/1.1.765), [version history](https://registry.npmjs.org/@firestone-hs/simulate-bgs-battle), [reference-data metadata](https://registry.npmjs.org/@firestone-hs/reference-data/3.0.213)

Inspected `dist/cards/impl/minion/fishbait.js` in 1.1.755: it buffs the living entity stored in `lastAffectedByEntity` by 5/5 or 10/10. Its `card.interface.d.ts` includes spell/battlecry/attack/deathrattle hooks; this is useful executable behavior, not a shop action planner. No JS implementation references Lionfish `BG36_201`, Living Prison `BG36_180`, or Ornate Clock. Arcane Absorption's ID appears in Leyline Surfacer's reward logic, which does not implement casting Arcane Absorption. [Inspected immutable tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/@firestone-hs/simulate-bgs-battle/-/simulate-bgs-battle-1.1.755.tgz)

### 4. Amalgadon: new provider, familiar underlying data

The April announcement advertises anonymous `/api/cards`; that URL returned **403** here. Current docs and the live discovery index instead describe **`/api/v1`**; card/card-list/minion/patch endpoints require Bearer tokens. Anonymous discovery returned **200**, card lookup **401**. Bulk export is limited to five requests/hour. The documented schema supplies IDs, text, stats, tier, races, mechanics and golden links, but no recruit transitions, token execution graph or live activation counters. No API key was requested. [Announcement](https://www.amalgadon.com/blog/developer-api), [current docs](https://www.amalgadon.com/developers), [live index](https://www.amalgadon.com/api/v1)

Its underlying card data comes from HearthstoneJSON. Terms identify original site code as proprietary and retain ownership of users' authored board notes with their authors; a public build is not permission to mirror all notes as a training corpus. Useful as a supplementary lookup/sharing provider, with no established advantage over raw CardDefs for these failures. [Terms](https://www.amalgadon.com/terms)

### 5. Official source and other rule-engine candidates

Blizzard's card guide exposes Battlegrounds tier/upgraded variants via `gameMode=battlegrounds`; client credentials provide OAuth access. Neither documentation establishes executable effect scripts or live entity readiness. Official 36.6.3 notes dated October 1 document substantial changes, including Living Azerite's stat scaling, which should invalidate affected effect definitions. [Game-mode guide](https://community.developer.battle.net/documentation/hearthstone/guides/game-modes), [OAuth guide](https://community.developer.battle.net/documentation/guides/using-oauth/client-credentials-flow), [official patch notes](https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/en-gb/news/24303864/36-6-3-patch-notes)

The community engines checked do not solve current coverage: **RosettaStone** is AGPL-3.0; its Battlegrounds catalogue has empty hero/power functions and none of the target IDs. **battlegrounds-rs** is MIT, last pushed September 2022, with features/quick-start still TBA. **BGSimulator** last pushed January 2020 and its README reserves all rights. Repository activity alone is insufficient proof of maintained Battlegrounds rules. [RosettaStone catalogue](https://github.com/utilForever/RosettaStone/blob/main/Sources/Rosetta/Battlegrounds/CardSets/BattlegroundsCardsGen.cpp), [license](https://github.com/utilForever/RosettaStone/blob/main/LICENSE), [Rust project metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/utilForever/battlegrounds-rs), [Rust README](https://github.com/utilForever/battlegrounds-rs), [BGSimulator metadata](https://api.github.com/repos/yossielimelech/BGSimulator), [BGSimulator README](https://github.com/yossielimelech/BGSimulator)

## Proposed integration seams

1. **`HSData/CardDB.swift` + `CardDataStore.swift`:** load a compact, build-pinned CardDefs sidecar preserving tag IDs, script defaults, evolution/golden DBF links and definition provenance. Keep printed defaults separate from live entity values. A definition's 4089/4090 does not prove that this particular Lionfish is currently ready or still costs its printed price.
2. **`BattleInputBuilder.recruitContext` in `RecruitContext.swift`:** expand dependencies by DBF links to a visited-set closure, instead of relying only on the hardcoded token list. Include golden variants and referenced tokens; resolve missing dependency IDs before offering an action. Treat HSBG mention links as supporting hints, not authoritative execution edges.
3. **One recruit effect catalogue used by `RecruitEffects`, `RecruitActivations` and `RecruitMechanics`:** encode validated primitives such as targeted stat buffs, pending-next-purchase stat copies, token transforms and resolved one-time effects. Map canonical effect families to those primitives, parameterized by verified tags/text. Keep explicit handlers for complex attack/trigger interactions. Carry build range, normalized-text fingerprint, dependencies and supported trigger/event types with every entry.
4. **Generate the inventory offline:** parse exact-build XML; verify root build; index CardID and DBF; enumerate active pool cards plus reachable tokens/enchantments; classify activation, battlecry, end-turn, buy/sell, spell and acquisition effects; compare against catalogue capabilities. Report separate `metadata missing`, `dependency missing`, `rule missing`, `live state missing`, and `definition changed` counts. Unknowns remain visible. Use 253216 for this replay, and a separate 253932 report for current play.
5. **Validate transitions against recorded before/after states:** exact Fortify targets, Clock after acquisition, Lionfish/Fishbait with relevant attack/deathrattle triggers, Living Prison's next-buy expiration/doubling, and Arcane Absorption's ties/rounding. A coverage inventory is not proof of effect correctness, and combat odds are not proof of better strategic decisions.

These are proposed changes, not implemented integrations. Existing seams: [context construction](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitContext.swift), [effect interpreter](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitEffects.swift), [activation actions/apply](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitActivations.swift), [trigger/support gates](../../Sources/BGIntel/Advisor/RecruitMechanics.swift).
